verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a broad public API, CLI, and MCP server covering many UI actions (transactions, cards, bill approval, travel booking, expense management) per ramp-docs-1,3,4,5,6,29,30, but no documentation explicitly claims full feature parity between API/CLI/MCP and the UI, and several UI-only workflows (e.g., detailed policy configuration, multi-entity setup, procurement OCR flows) are not shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or exhaustive endpoint list covering all UI functions, and independent confirmation that no UI-only gaps exist.
